name: Retail Inventory Manager
description: Focuses on stock levels, product tables, sorting, and conditional restock alerts

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you manage inventory records in Excel?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I keep a table with headers like Item, Quantity, and ReorderLevel. To find low stock items, I can sort the table by Quantity ascending, which moves entire rows together so product names stay matched.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you flag items that need reordering?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: In column D I use an IF formula: =IF(B2<=C2,"Reorder","OK"). If the current stock B2 is less than reorder level C2, it says Reorder. I copy this down all rows.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you format long product descriptions and prices?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: For long names I turn on wrap text and adjust alignment so the text fits nicely without spilling over. For prices, I apply currency format.
